summary: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the company's intention to enter the AI Smart Living sector to explore new growth opportunities. The release outlines plans to leverage existing media and creator networks, establish a BVI holding company and Singapore operating entity, and pursue strategic partnerships in smart home products and services. No definitive agreements, specific terms, pricing, or transaction structures are disclosed. The filing is a strategic directional announcement without binding commitments, not a special-situation event. No risk-arb angle is available.
